story.titleZh: 哈斯车队宣布奥孔将于2026赛季结束后离队
story.summaryZh: TGR哈斯F1车队在X平台宣布，车队与埃斯特班·奥孔将在2026赛季结束后分道扬镳，双方将携手拼搏至赛季最后一场比赛。

story.originalTitle: TGR Haas F1 Team and Esteban Ocon will part ways at the conclusion of the 2026 season. With plenty of racing ahead, our focus remains on working toget...
story.summaryEn:
TGR Haas F1 Team and Esteban Ocon will part ways at the conclusion of the 2026 season.
With plenty of racing ahead, our focus remains on working together to maximize every opportunity through to the final race of the year.
#HaasF1 #F1
detailZh:
TGR哈斯F1车队与埃斯特班·奥孔将在2026赛季结束后分道扬镳。
“前方还有许多比赛在等着我们，我们的重心仍是共同努力，最大限度把握本赛季最后一场比赛之前的每一个机会。”——TGR哈斯F1车队
detailEn:
TGR Haas F1 Team and Esteban Ocon will part ways at the conclusion of the 2026 season.
With plenty of racing ahead, our focus remains on working together to maximize every opportunity through to the final race of the year.
#HaasF1 #F1
